description: Download videos and thumbnails from a completed video search by result id (videos[].id), at most 10 per call. Returns, per video, a free thumbnail link and a signed video link that expires at expiresAt. Thumbnails are free; each delivered video costs 1 credit, charged once per workspace and video when its link is delivered, so asking again later for fresh links is free. The reply comes back within about 10 seconds: a video still being fetched is pending, so send the same request again after about 30 seconds. A video that could not be delivered is never charged; its status is unavailable, with reason and nextStep. When the credits cover none of the videos, the result is upgrade_required with a message and upgrade link, and nothing ran; after an upgrade, the same request with the same idempotency key runs it. When they cover only some, the delivered links are kept and unfunded names the rest and what to do.

idempotencyKey.description: Generate once per intended download and reuse for retries.

ids.description: Result ids (videos[].id) from this search, at most 10 per call.

jobId.description: jobId of the completed search. Omit only for a search answered from the cache, and pass search instead.

search.description: For a search answered from the cache (cacheOnly, no jobId): its downloadFrom.search.

signedUrlSeconds.description: How long the download links last.

videos.description: false returns only the free thumbnails.

name: socialseal_download_search_videos
title: Download search videos
